quotes.speaker: LaMelo Ball

quotes.quote: Never getting comfortable, always just building habits, good habits, just trying to win and do the right stuff. You don't want to work on no bad habits.

quotes.speaker: LaMelo Ball
quotes.summary_phrase: LaMelo Ball on the importance of staying hungry
quotes.excerpt: human nature, you know how it goes when you up 30 usually, everybody take their foot off
quotes.quote: Human nature, you know how it goes when you up 30 usually. Everybody take their foot off the gas. I mean everyone, for real, the fans, the refs, I mean everybody just take a little seat back. So I mean, you just keep going, I feel like it just gets the game over with.
quotes.social_post: LaMelo Ball on human nature when up 30: Everybody take their foot off the gas. I mean everyone, for real, the fans, the refs, I mean everybody just take a little seat back. So I mean, you just keep going.

structured.context: LaMelo Ball explains the importance of maintaining intensity even when the team has a large lead.
